top_signals.title: Dubai Luxury Home Sales Fall From Record Levels as War Drags On
top_signals.summary: Wealthy buyers from around the world continued to snap up Dubai luxury homes during the third quarter, according to researcher Knight Frank, although sales volumes declined about 17% from last year as the Iran war dragged on.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Oil-Rich Alberta Votes to Stay in Canada in Historic Referendum
top_signals.summary: Albertans have rejected a proposal to move toward a separation from Canada, according to early results of the referendum held on Monday, as voters gave the federal government a boost to national unity. Residents of Canada’s oil province have voted to remain in Canada, CBC News projects based on the early results with still more than half of the votes to be counted. top_signals.summary: The sharp selloff in French government bonds is a reminder that an intensifying battle for capital is putting borrowers under greater scrutiny, particularly in a world awash with high yields, according to the BlackRock Investment Institute.
